sources.title: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands Gazette No. 1 (27 January 2026), Notice No. 4 (23 January 2026): Public Holidays 2026
sources.said: In accordance with section 73 of the Interpretation and General Clauses Ordinance 1977, I declare that the following dates will be public holidays for South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands during 2026:- 1 January New Year’s Day 19 January Possession Day (in lieu of 17 January) 3 April Good Friday 27 April Liberation Day (in lieu of 25 April) 20 May Shackleton Day 22 June Mid-winter Day (in lieu of 21 June) 30 October Environment Day 25 December Christmas Day 28 December Boxing Day (in lieu of 26 December). Dated 23 January 2026 C. MARTIN-REYNOLDS C.M.G., Commissioner.
